A dramatic illustration of the fiery furnace. On the outside, a shocked King Nebuchadnezzar stands in his royal robes looking into a large brick furnace. Inside the glowing orange and yellow flames, four figures walk calmly and unbound. Three are dressed in ancient Babylonian tunics, and the fourth figure glows with a bright, divine light.

A desert scene at the foot of Mount Sinai. In the centre, a golden statue of a young bull (calf) sits on a stone pedestal. A large crowd of Israelites is dancing, eating, and celebrating around it. In the foreground, Aaron looks on nervously. In the background, Moses is coming down the rocky mountain carrying two stone tablets, his face filled with anger.
